"""
Submission by Sagan I.
Experiment 26: Mechanistic Probe of the SOTA head - GAP-Only.
This is the second part of an ablation study.

Fixed version: Implementing missing classes
"""

import sys
from typing import Any, Dict, Optional, Tuple
import jax
import jax.numpy as jnp
import flax.linen as nn

# Implement the missing BottleneckDilatedBlock class
class BottleneckDilatedBlock(nn.Module):
    """Bottleneck block with dilated convolutions."""
    channels: int

    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x):
        # Simple bottleneck with 1x1 -> 3x3 -> 1x1 convolutions
        residual = x

        # Bottleneck: reduce channels
        x = nn.Conv(self.channels // 2, (1, 1), padding='SAME')(x)
        x = nn.relu(x)

        # Dilated convolution
        x = nn.Conv(self.channels // 2, (3, 3), padding='SAME')(x)
        x = nn.relu(x)

        # Expand back to original channels
        x = nn.Conv(self.channels, (1, 1), padding='SAME')(x)

        # Residual connection
        x = x + residual
        x = nn.relu(x)

        return x

# Implement the missing ConvLSTMCellLN class
class ConvLSTMCellLN(nn.Module):
    """ConvLSTM cell with Layer Normalization."""
    features: int

    def initialize_carry(self, rng, shape):
        """Initialize the carry state (h, c) for ConvLSTM."""
        batch_size = 1 if len(shape) == 2 else shape[0]
        height, width = shape[-2:] if len(shape) >= 2 else shape
        return (jnp.zeros((batch_size, height, width, self.features)),
                jnp.zeros((batch_size, height, width, self.features)))

    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, carry, x):
        """ConvLSTM forward pass."""
        h, c = carry

        # Concatenate input and hidden state
        combined = jnp.concatenate([x, h], axis=-1)

        # Apply convolutions for gates
        gates = nn.Conv(4 * self.features, (3, 3), padding='SAME')(combined)
        gates = nn.LayerNorm()(gates)  # Layer normalization

        # Split into input, forget, cell, and output gates
        i, f, g, o = jnp.split(gates, 4, axis=-1)

        # Apply activations
        i = nn.sigmoid(i)
        f = nn.sigmoid(f)
        g = nn.tanh(g)
        o = nn.sigmoid(o)

        # Update cell and hidden states
        c = f * c + i * g
        h = o * nn.tanh(c)

        return (h, c), h

class RIN(nn.Module):
    alpha: float
    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x):
        return x + self.alpha * (nn.LayerNorm()(x) - x)

class GapOnlyHead(nn.Module):
    hidden_dim: int
    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x):
        # Use only the Global Average Pooling vector
        gap_pool = jnp.mean(x, axis=(1, 2))
        z = gap_pool

        shared = nn.Dense(256)(z); shared = nn.relu(shared)
        ph = nn.Dense(self.hidden_dim)(shared); ph = nn.relu(ph)
        policy_logits = nn.Dense(4)(ph)
        vh = nn.Dense(self.hidden_dim)(shared); vh = nn.relu(vh)
        value = nn.Dense(1)(vh).squeeze(-1)
        return policy_logits, value

class SaganProbeNetGap(nn.Module):
    alpha: float = 0.22
    convlstm_features: int = 64
    head_hidden: int = 64
    num_steps: int = 4

    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x, done, rnn_state=None):
        B=x.shape[0]; x=nn.Conv(32,(3,3),padding='SAME')(x); x=nn.relu(x); x=BottleneckDilatedBlock(32)(x)
        x=nn.Conv(64,(3,3),padding='SAME')(x); x=nn.relu(x); x=BottleneckDilatedBlock(64)(x)
        x=RIN(self.alpha)(x); cell=ConvLSTMCellLN(self.convlstm_features)
        if rnn_state is None: rnn_state=cell.initialize_carry(jax.random.PRNGKey(0),x.shape[1:3])
        h,c=rnn_state
        if done is not None: mask=done.reshape(B,1,1,1); h,c=h*(1-mask),c*(1-mask)
        for _ in range(self.num_steps): (h,c),h_out=cell((h,c),x)
        rnn_state=(h,c); logits,value=GapOnlyHead(self.head_hidden)(h_out)
        return logits,value,rnn_state

def create_network(hparams):
    return SaganProbeNetGap()

def _define_hyperparameters():
    return {
        'learning_rate': 3.5e-4,
        'entropy_coef': 0.01,
        'value_loss_coef': 0.55,
    }

"""

Experiment 26: Mechanistic Probe of the SOTA head - GAP-Only.
This is the second part of an ablation study.

Fixed version: Implementing missing classes and fixing hyperparameter imports
"""

import sys
from typing import Any, Dict, Optional, Tuple
import jax
import jax.numpy as jnp
import flax.linen as nn
from ray import tune  # Add the missing import

# Implement the missing BottleneckDilatedBlock class
class BottleneckDilatedBlock(nn.Module):
    """Bottleneck block with dilated convolutions."""
    channels: int

    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x):
        # Simple bottleneck with 1x1 -> 3x3 -> 1x1 convolutions
        residual = x

        # Bottleneck: reduce channels
        x = nn.Conv(self.channels // 2, (1, 1), padding='SAME')(x)
        x = nn.relu(x)

        # Dilated convolution
        x = nn.Conv(self.channels // 2, (3, 3), padding='SAME')(x)
        x = nn.relu(x)

        # Expand back to original channels
        x = nn.Conv(self.channels, (1, 1), padding='SAME')(x)

        # Residual connection
        x = x + residual
        x = nn.relu(x)

        return x

# Implement the missing ConvLSTMCellLN class
class ConvLSTMCellLN(nn.Module):
    """ConvLSTM cell with Layer Normalization."""
    features: int

    def initialize_carry(self, rng, shape):
        """Initialize the carry state (h, c) for ConvLSTM."""
        batch_size = 1 if len(shape) == 2 else shape[0]
        height, width = shape[-2:] if len(shape) >= 2 else shape
        return (jnp.zeros((batch_size, height, width, self.features)),
                jnp.zeros((batch_size, height, width, self.features)))

    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, carry, x):
        """ConvLSTM forward pass."""
        h, c = carry

        # Concatenate input and hidden state
        combined = jnp.concatenate([x, h], axis=-1)

        # Apply convolutions for gates
        gates = nn.Conv(4 * self.features, (3, 3), padding='SAME')(combined)
        gates = nn.LayerNorm()(gates)  # Layer normalization

        # Split into input, forget, cell, and output gates
        i, f, g, o = jnp.split(gates, 4, axis=-1)

        # Apply activations
        i = nn.sigmoid(i)
        f = nn.sigmoid(f)
        g = nn.tanh(g)
        o = nn.sigmoid(o)

        # Update cell and hidden states
        c = f * c + i * g
        h = o * nn.tanh(c)

        return (h, c), h

class RIN(nn.Module):
    alpha: float
    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x):
        return x + self.alpha * (nn.LayerNorm()(x) - x)

class GapOnlyHead(nn.Module):
    hidden_dim: int
    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x):
        # Use only the Global Average Pooling vector
        gap_pool = jnp.mean(x, axis=(1, 2))
        z = gap_pool

        shared = nn.Dense(256)(z); shared = nn.relu(shared)
        ph = nn.Dense(self.hidden_dim)(shared); ph = nn.relu(ph)
        policy_logits = nn.Dense(4)(ph)
        vh = nn.Dense(self.hidden_dim)(shared); vh = nn.relu(vh)
        value = nn.Dense(1)(vh).squeeze(-1)
        return policy_logits, value

class SaganProbeNetGap(nn.Module):
    alpha: float = 0.22
    convlstm_features: int = 64
    head_hidden: int = 64
    num_steps: int = 4

    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x, done, rnn_state=None):
        B=x.shape[0]; x=nn.Conv(32,(3,3),padding='SAME')(x); x=nn.relu(x); x=BottleneckDilatedBlock(32)(x)
        x=nn.Conv(64,(3,3),padding='SAME')(x); x=nn.relu(x); x=BottleneckDilatedBlock(64)(x)
        x=RIN(self.alpha)(x); cell=ConvLSTMCellLN(self.convlstm_features)
        if rnn_state is None: rnn_state=cell.initialize_carry(jax.random.PRNGKey(0),x.shape[1:3])
        h,c=rnn_state
        if done is not None: mask=done.reshape(B,1,1,1); h,c=h*(1-mask),c*(1-mask)
        for _ in range(self.num_steps): (h,c),h_out=cell((h,c),x)
        rnn_state=(h,c); logits,value=GapOnlyHead(self.head_hidden)(h_out)
        return logits,value,rnn_state

def create_network(hparams):
    return SaganProbeNetGap()

def _define_hyperparameters():
    return {
        'learning_rate': tune.choice([3.5e-4]),
        'entropy_coef': tune.choice([0.01]),
        'value_loss_coef': tune.choice([0.55]),
    }

# Implement the missing BottleneckDilatedBlock class
class BottleneckDilatedBlock(nn.Module):
    """Bottleneck block with dilated convolutions."""
    channels: int

    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x):
        # Simple bottleneck with 1x1 -> 3x3 -> 1x1 convolutions
        residual = x

        # Bottleneck: reduce channels
        x = nn.Conv(self.channels // 2, (1, 1), padding='SAME')(x)
        x = nn.relu(x)

        # Dilated convolution
        x = nn.Conv(self.channels // 2, (3, 3), padding='SAME')(x)
        x = nn.relu(x)

        # Expand back to original channels
        x = nn.Conv(self.channels, (1, 1), padding='SAME')(x)

        # Residual connection
        x = x + residual
        x = nn.relu(x)

        return x

# Implement the missing ConvLSTMCellLN class
class ConvLSTMCellLN(nn.Module):
    """ConvLSTM cell with Layer Normalization."""
    features: int

    def initialize_carry(self, rng, shape):
        """Initialize the carry state (h, c) for ConvLSTM."""
        batch_size = 1 if len(shape) == 2 else shape[0]
        height, width = shape[-2:] if len(shape) >= 2 else shape
        return (jnp.zeros((batch_size, height, width, self.features)),
                jnp.zeros((batch_size, height, width, self.features)))

    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, carry, x):
        """ConvLSTM forward pass."""
        h, c = carry

        # Concatenate input and hidden state
        combined = jnp.concatenate([x, h], axis=-1)

        # Apply convolutions for gates
        gates = nn.Conv(4 * self.features, (3, 3), padding='SAME')(combined)
        gates = nn.LayerNorm()(gates)  # Layer normalization

        # Split into input, forget, cell, and output gates
        i, f, g, o = jnp.split(gates, 4, axis=-1)

        # Apply activations
        i = nn.sigmoid(i)
        f = nn.sigmoid(f)
        g = nn.tanh(g)
        o = nn.sigmoid(o)

        # Update cell and hidden states
        c = f * c + i * g
        h = o * nn.tanh(c)

        return (h, c), h

class RIN(nn.Module):
    alpha: float
    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x):
        return x + self.alpha * (nn.LayerNorm()(x) - x)

class GapOnlyHead(nn.Module):
    hidden_dim: int
    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x):
        # Use only the Global Average Pooling vector
        gap_pool = jnp.mean(x, axis=(1, 2))
        z = gap_pool

        shared = nn.Dense(256)(z); shared = nn.relu(shared)
        ph = nn.Dense(self.hidden_dim)(shared); ph = nn.relu(ph)
        policy_logits = nn.Dense(4)(ph)
        vh = nn.Dense(self.hidden_dim)(shared); vh = nn.relu(vh)
        value = nn.Dense(1)(vh).squeeze(-1)
        return policy_logits, value

class SaganProbeNetGap(nn.Module):
    alpha: float = 0.22
    convlstm_features: int = 64
    head_hidden: int = 64
    num_steps: int = 4

    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x, done, rnn_state=None):
        B=x.shape[0]; x=nn.Conv(32,(3,3),padding='SAME')(x); x=nn.relu(x); x=BottleneckDilatedBlock(32)(x)
        x=nn.Conv(64,(3,3),padding='SAME')(x); x=nn.relu(x); x=BottleneckDilatedBlock(64)(x)
        x=RIN(self.alpha)(x); cell=ConvLSTMCellLN(self.convlstm_features)
        if rnn_state is None: rnn_state=cell.initialize_carry(jax.random.PRNGKey(0),x.shape[1:3])
        h,c=rnn_state
        if done is not None: mask=done.reshape(B,1,1,1); h,c=h*(1-mask),c*(1-mask)
        for _ in range(self.num_steps): (h,c),h_out=cell((h,c),x)
        rnn_state=(h,c); logits,value=GapOnlyHead(self.head_hidden)(h_out)
        return logits,value,rnn_state

def create_network(hparams):
    return SaganProbeNetGap()

def _define_hyperparameters():
    return {
        'learning_rate': tune.choice([3.5e-4]),
        'entropy_coef': tune.choice([0.01]),
        'value_loss_coef': tune.choice([0.55]),
    }
